name: Fei
main_effect:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If you have a Digimon with the [Royal Base] or [CS] trait, gain 1 memory.
[All Turns] When cards are placed face up in your security stack, if any of them have the [Zaxon] or [Royal Base] trait, by suspending this Tamer, gain 1 memory. Then, if you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
